modes.name: normal
modes.summary: Live-faithful async lifecycle: text-JSON ack, queued->running->done by polls, outputs with signed URLs.

modes.name: ambiguous_no_structured_content
modes.summary: Job is created and billed; the ack is prose with no job id and no structuredContent.

modes.name: ambiguous_empty_content
modes.summary: Job is created and billed; the result content list is empty.

modes.name: ambiguous_malformed_ack
modes.summary: Job is created and billed; the ack text is truncated JSON.

modes.name: ambiguous_protocol_error_after_create
modes.summary: Job is created and billed, then the call fails with a JSON-RPC error.

modes.name: ambiguous_timeout_after_create
modes.summary: Job is created and billed, then the handler hangs past the caller's timeout.

modes.name: delayed_list_visibility
modes.summary: A new job stays absent from studiotwin_list_my_jobs for the first 2 list calls.

modes.name: price_change_interim
modes.summary: Run selects another provider and charges estimate+12; no server maximum; dispatches once.

modes.name: price_change_server_max
modes.summary: Proposed D30: maxCredits enforced; a run above it returns PRICE_EXCEEDS_MAX before any debit.

modes.name: max_credits_advertised_not_enforced
modes.summary: Probe trap: the D30 capability is advertised but maxCredits is silently ignored.

modes.name: settlement_evidence
modes.summary: Proposed API: job status carries job-specific final debit/refund evidence.

modes.name: job_failure
modes.summary: Jobs end failed with a safe error; the reserved credits are refunded.

modes.name: long_running
modes.summary: Jobs stay running for 50 polls (pano-stickers can run for hours).

modes.name: insufficient_balance
modes.summary: Wallet holds 3 credits; priced runs fail with code 40001 and create no job.

modes.name: secret_channels
modes.summary: Every result channel carries a unique canary: text, embedded/fenced JSON, structuredContent, resource links, embedded resources, _meta, isError results, progress and logs.

modes.name: secret_protocol_error
modes.summary: secret_channels, but the failing call returns a JSON-RPC error with canaries in message and data.

modes.name: new_unclassified_tool
modes.summary: tools/list carries the 45 captured tools plus one unclassified billable tool.

modes.name: new_tool_midsession
modes.summary: The unclassified tool appears after the first tools/call and tools/list_changed is sent.

modes.name: schema_drift
modes.summary: text-to-environment-map keeps its name but gains a required input (schema hash changes).

modes.name: malformed_status
modes.summary: studiotwin_get_job_status returns an HTML error page as text.

modes.name: malformed_concept
modes.summary: Concept structuredContent violates the captured outputSchema.

modes.name: mixed_timestamps
modes.summary: Job timestamps mix ISO-8601 Z, ISO with offset, epoch milliseconds and {$date} forms.

modes.name: described_status_vocabulary
modes.summary: Statuses use the tool description's QUEUED/RUNNING/COMPLETE/FAILED words, not the API's.

modes.name: optional_outputs_omitted
modes.summary: Jobs return only required outputs (world without skyMap, auto-rig metadata-only).

modes.name: expiring_signed_urls
modes.summary: Signed URLs expire 60 s after issue on the fake clock.

modes.name: slow_calls
modes.summary: Every tools/call sleeps 0.3 s first.

modes.name: concept_active_asset_race
modes.summary: Between quote and edit the Concept's active asset swaps A->B, so the submission differs.

modes.name: http_sse
modes.summary: Streamable HTTP with SSE responses (progress/log notifications flow).

modes.name: http_rate_limited
modes.summary: The first 2 POSTs get HTTP 429 with Retry-After: 1.

modes.name: http_redirect_foreign
modes.summary: POST /mcp answers 307 to a foreign origin whose Location carries a signed canary.

modes.name: http_redirect_same_origin
modes.summary: POST /mcp answers 307 to /mcp-moved on the same origin (allowed redirect).

modes.name: http_error_body
modes.summary: POST /mcp answers 502 with a diagnostic body quoting a signed URL canary.
